**Ugarte Joins Manchester United in €60m Deal**

Manchester United finalized the acquisition of Manuel Ugarte from Paris Saint-Germain on Friday evening. The deal, valued at €50m (£42m) with a potential €10m in bonuses, sees the Uruguayan international committing his future to the Old Trafford club. Ugarte expressed his commitment to winning silverware and restoring the team to its former glory.

The 23-year-old midfielder has inked a five-year contract, with the option to extend for an additional year. He represents Erik ten Hag's fifth significant signing of the transfer window, providing the manager with another experienced holding midfielder to complement Casemiro.

"It is an incredible feeling to join a club of this magnitude – one that is admired all around the world," Ugarte stated. "The project that the football leadership discussed with me is extremely exciting. Manchester United is an ambitious club and I am an ambitious player."

He continued, "I know how incredible United fans are and I cannot wait to experience Old Trafford. I’m someone who is so determined to succeed. I will sacrifice and give everything for my teammates. Together we will fight to win trophies and reach the level where this club needs to be.”

Dan Ashworth, United’s sporting director, highlighted the importance of the signing. “Signing Manuel was another of our primary targets for this summer."

Any other questions?
